GRADE 6 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Composition of Air in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the components of air,
   B. Learners should ignore Composition of Air completely.
   C. Composition of Air is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Composition of Air.

2. About Composition of Air around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. outline uses of the different components of air,
   B. Learners should ignore Composition of Air completely.
   C. Composition of Air is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Composition of Air.

3. About Composition of Air in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the effects of air pollution in the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Composition of Air completely.
   C. Composition of Air is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Composition of Air.

5. About Light in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate the movement of light through materials,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

6. About Light around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. draw ray diagrams of images formed in plane mirrors,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

7. About Light in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate the formation of shadows and eclipses in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

9. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

10. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

11. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

12. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Composition of Air in your school compound.
